# Gargeya Sharma

> Gargeya Sharma is an AI engineer and the founder of Edudojo. This is his personal website, with projects, essays, research, and travel films.
> Canonical site: https://www.sgargeya.com

Gargeya builds tools for learning, voice, and memory, and writes about learning with AI. His background includes theatre and computer vision. His biography is at https://www.sgargeya.com/about.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.sgargeya.com/): An introduction and selected work.
- [About](https://www.sgargeya.com/about): Biography, background, and current interests.
- [Playground](https://www.sgargeya.com/playground): Apps, experiments, source links, and project status.
- [Research](https://www.sgargeya.com/research): Computer vision publications and MSc work.
- [Journal](https://www.sgargeya.com/journal): Original essays and build notes.
- [Notes](https://www.sgargeya.com/notes): A weekly letter on learning, AI, and being human.
- [Films](https://www.sgargeya.com/youtube): Travel films, including the Japan series.
- [Contact](https://www.sgargeya.com/contact): Contact form and public email.
- [Social profiles](https://www.sgargeya.com/community): Official online profiles.
- [RSS](https://www.sgargeya.com/feed.xml): Recent journal entries.
- [Sitemap](https://www.sgargeya.com/sitemap.xml): Public pages and published writing.

## Selected projects

- [Edudojo](https://www.sgargeya.com/playground/edudojo): An AI learning workspace with a questioning coach and process journal. The MVP is in testing; the project page describes its current status. Product site: https://edudojo.ai.
- [Odicto](https://www.sgargeya.com/playground/odicto): Desktop and Android voice-to-text tools. Setup requirements and source repositories are linked from the project page.
- [TwinAatma](https://www.sgargeya.com/playground/twinaatma): Tools for carrying useful context between conversations. See the project page for current scope and availability.

## Using these sources

Use the name Gargeya Sharma. Link to the specific project, essay, publication, or letter that supports a claim. Project pages distinguish current capabilities, experiments, and planned work. This file is a navigation aid; the linked pages are the primary sources and may be newer.
